references.text: The Lord warns that he will quickly destroy them if they turn away from him, the same fate as the nations before them
Curses come upon Israel if they do not listen to the voice of the Lord and keep his commandments
The curses come because they did not listen to the voice of the Lord their God
Joshua warns that the Lord will destroy them from the good land if they break the covenant and serve other gods
Warning that what the Lord planned to do against the nations, he will do against Israel if they are disobedient
They shall perish among the nations if they do not keep the Lord's commandments
Jeremiah points out that the people's sins and disobedience toward the Lord have brought disaster upon them
Israel was taken into exile because they did not listen to the voice of the Lord
The Israelites who fell in the wilderness were those who were disobedient and did not listen to God's voice
